name: tripo-watchtower-01
prompt: A medieval stone watchtower keep about 40 metres tall on a stepped stone plinth, square lower shaft with corner buttresses, three tapering tiers of weathered grey ashlar masonry, string courses, narrow arrow slits, a timber hoarding gallery near the top, crenellations, and an open stone platform with a large iron fire brazier cradle on the front. Slate pyramid roof at the rear. Realistic, weathered, moss in the joints.

name: tripo-watchtower-02
prompt: A ruined round stone watchtower on a rocky outcrop, about 35 metres tall, rough grey fieldstone masonry with lichen, a broken crenellated top with a wide iron fire basket on a stone platform, small arched windows, a heavy wooden door at the base. Realistic, weathered, game asset.

name: tripo-spire-01
prompt: A slender ancient stone spire tower about 44 metres tall, tapering octagonal shaft of dark weathered stone with carved bands and bronze rings at intervals, ending in an open bronze cradle of curved prongs that holds a glowing crystal orb at the top. Mossy square stone base. Realistic, old, game asset.

name: tripo-hoard-01
prompt: A dragon's treasure hoard heaped on bare rock, a wide mound of gold coins about 16 metres across and 5 metres high, spilling goblets, crowns, jewelled swords, gemstones, a few open wooden chests overflowing with gold, scattered coins at the edges. Realistic, detailed, game asset.

name: tripo-hoard-02
prompt: A low treasure trove about 14 metres across and 4 metres high: iron-bound wooden chests, broken urns, a shield, gold bars and piles of gold coins around a flat stone slab, partly covered with rubble and old bones. Realistic, detailed, game asset.

name: tripo-wardstone-01
prompt: A floating ward stone: seven tall dark basalt shards carved with deep rune grooves, arranged in a ring around an empty central socket, held together by two thick studded iron bands, one long shard pointing down beneath as a keel. About 12 metres wide and 15 metres tall. Realistic, ancient, game asset.

name: tripo-ruin-01
prompt: The ruined lower walls of an old stone shrine in a mountain meadow, broken grey masonry walls about 3 metres high forming a square 12 metres across, a fallen column, an arched doorway still standing, moss and grass in the cracks. Realistic, game asset.

name: tripo-cairn-01
prompt: A tall stacked stone cairn waymarker about 3 metres high on a mountain pass, flat grey stones piled in a cone, lichen, a weathered wooden pole at the top with a torn cloth. Realistic photogrammetry style.

name: tripo-bones-01
prompt: The weathered skeleton of a huge horned beast lying on the ground, ribcage, long spine, skull with curved horns, bleached bones partly sunk in the earth, about 10 metres long. Realistic, game asset.
